descriptions.cole: Cole: mature square face, blue eyes, swept brown undercut, dense short beard, olive green flight suit with rolled sleeves, dark harness and silver hardware, fingerless gloves, knee pads and tall laced boots.
descriptions.axel: Axel: muscular adult Black man, short close-cropped black hair, neat full black beard, gold aviator sunglasses, blue flight jacket/trousers with cream shearling collar, black undershirt, silver dog tags, black gloves and combat boots, thigh holster.
descriptions.decker: Decker: adult fair-skinned clean-shaven man, swept blond hair, black rectangular clear-lens eyeglasses, squared mature face, black high-collar tactical flight suit with fine gold circuit seams and lightning shoulder patches, black/gold boots and gloves.
descriptions.maverick: Maverick: mature tan-skinned man, swept auburn-brown hair, neatly trimmed strong beard, green-lens gold aviator sunglasses in EVERY face-visible view, olive camo flight jumpsuit and black harness, silver buckles, black gloves and boots, two thigh holsters. Keep glasses and never turn him into Cole.
descriptions.freezer: Freezer: mature tan-skinned athletic man, angular face, black moustache and short beard, long black hair in high ponytail with purple tie, no glasses. Purple padded flight suit with cream shearling collar, black harness and pouches, riveted knee pads, black gloves and tall lace-up boots.
descriptions.juggernaut: Juggernaut: very heavily muscled tan adult male biker, slick short dark-brown undercut, strong full beard, black gold-rim aviator sunglasses, tattooed bare arms, open studded sleeveless black leather vest with orange skull insignia and bare muscular chest, black leather trousers with belt/waist chain, black fingerless gloves, heavy black/orange skull boots.
descriptions.yuri: Yuri: mature light/tan-skinned man with short brown mohawk crest, shaved sides, full short dark beard/moustache and stern brows. Black scarf, red high-collar flight suit, silver harness hardware, black fingerless gloves, red knee pads and black/red combat boots. No messy anime hair or clean-shaven youth.
descriptions.lizzie: Lizzie: adult warm tan-skinned woman with green eyes, long voluminous curly auburn hair, large gold hoop earrings, gold necklace and confident mature face. Golden-yellow flight suit over black undershirt, black harness and waist panels, utility belt, twin thigh straps, black gloves and black lace-up combat boots. Preserve garment coverage and natural adult proportions.
descriptions.falva: Falva: adult fair/warm-skinned woman with blue eyes, long thick wavy auburn hair swept to one side, black rectangular clear-lens eyeglasses. Magenta/pink full flight suit with black high collar and shoulder panels, gray harness/silver buckles, utility belt, double thigh straps, black fingerless gloves and tall lace-up combat boots. Preserve current glasses and natural adult proportions.
